description.value: Tetsa River Regional Park and Campground sits along the Alaska Highway just past Steamboat Mountain in the remote Northern Rockies of BC, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the iconic highway corridor. The park features trails suited to hiking, biking, and horseback riding, with 25 unserviced campsites available by reservation or drop-in. Its isolation and scenic river setting offer a genuine wilderness experience far from the nearest town.

address.value: Mile 580/KM 365 Alaska Highway, Northern Rockies, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence from the Northern Rockies Regional Municipality website confirms this is a real, operational regional park and campground at Mile 580/KM 365 of the Alaska Highway, ~96 km north of Fort Nelson. The website explicitly mentions biking trails and 25 unserviced campsites. No specific amenities such as bike racks, washrooms, or water sources are mentioned by name, so those are left null; 'unserviced' describes the campsites (no hookups) but does not confirm or deny communal washrooms or water. OSM had no phone or address, so website values are used for those fields.
concerns: OSM name 'Tetsa River Park' differs from the website name 'Tetsa River Regional Park and Campground'; OSM name retained per policy.
Website content was truncated mid-sentence on an 'UPDATE: As of March 2023...' notice — the nature of that update (possible permit or operational change) is unknown and may be material.
OSM record had no phone or address; both were sourced entirely from the website.
No specific amenity details (washrooms, water, bike racks) are described on the website, leaving required criteria unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate regional campground with biking trails on the Alaska Highway corridor — a key route for BC touring cyclists. It provides a confirmed overnight stop in an otherwise remote stretch north of Fort Nelson.
enrichment_extras.notes: A second campground booking phone number (250-774-6868) is listed on the website specifically for Tetsa River Campground Bookings. The main municipal number 250-774-2541 ext. 1 also handles reservations.

wow_evidence: Scenic river park and campground on the Alaska Highway past Steamboat Mountain; practical, pretty overnight stop.
blurb: Riverside regional park and campground on the Alaska Highway near Steamboat Mountain.
